info.title: Booking API
info.description: Courts and rooms at the club: availability, booking and cancelling. Times named start/end are UTC instants; localStart/localEnd are venue wall-clock times for display. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`.

post.summary: Creates an account and signs in. Bookings made on this browser before move to the new account.
Signs in. Bookings made on this browser while signed out move to the account.
Signs out: the auth cookie is removed and this browser is anonymous again.

get.summary: The signed-in account. 401 unauthenticated when nobody is signed in.

post.summary: Adds a court or room. It has no opening hours (so it is closed) until they are set.

put.summary: Changes a resource's name, kind, capacity, slot length or longest booking.

422.description: invalid_hours (the hours no longer fit the slot length)

delete.summary: Deletes a resource that has never been booked. Otherwise close it instead.

put.summary: Replaces a resource's weekly opening hours. Days left out are closed.

get.summary: Closures that overlap a range of venue-local days, venue-wide ones included.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day, inclusive; default 60 days after from.

post.summary: Closes one resource, or every resource (leave out resourceId), for whole days, such as a holiday.

delete.summary: Removes a closure: that time can be booked again.

put.summary: Changes the booking rules. They apply to new bookings and cancellations from now on.

get.summary: The audit log, newest first: who changed what, and when.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Only entries before this instant, to page back.

post.summary: Holds one or more consecutive slots: the first step of booking. Confirm the hold to book.
post.description:
The answer is a booking with status "pending" and holdExpiresAt: the slot is the customer's until then, and is
released if it is not confirmed in time. Send a slot's start exactly as the availability response gave it.
Someone may take the same slot first: then the answer is 409 slot_taken. Send an Idempotency-Key (a new GUID per booking, the same one on every retry of it) and a
retry returns the first answer instead of booking twice.

requestBody.description: Cancelled when the client goes away.

400.description: validation_failed: the body could not be read or a field is invalid (see errors)

422.description: too_soon, too_far_ahead, not_whole_slots, too_long, outside_opening_hours, not_on_slot_grid, resource_closed, name_required, too_many_bookings, idempotency_key_reused

post.summary: Confirms the current customer's hold, before it expires. Confirming twice is harmless.

get.summary: The current customer's bookings, oldest first.
One of the current customer's bookings.

post.summary: Cancels a booking while the cancellation rules allow it, or releases a hold at any time.

get.summary: Courts and rooms, with opening hours.
A resource's slots for one venue-local day.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The resource id, such as court-1.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: A venue-local day (yyyy-MM-dd). Leave it out for today at the venue.

400.description: validation_failed: the date could not be read

get.summary: Every resource's bookings (any status) and closures for one venue-local day, with the actions allowed on each booking.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: A venue-local day (yyyy-MM-dd). Leave it out for today at the venue.

post.summary: Records that a booking took place. Only once it has started.
Records that nobody came. Only once it has started.
Cancels any booking that has not ended, with a reason the customer sees. Frees the slot.
Blocks time on a resource (maintenance, an event) so customers cannot book it.

get.summary: The venue, its time zone and the booking rules.

roles.description: Customer, and Staff or Admin where granted.

resourceId.description: Leave out to close every resource (a holiday).

AdminClosureRequest.description: Close one resource, or the whole venue when resourceId is left out, for whole venue-local days.

AuditEntryResponse.description: One audit log entry: who changed what, and what it was before and after (JSON).

closures.description: Closures touching this day, so the UI can say why slots are closed.

BlockTimeRequest.description: Block time on a resource: start and end are UTC instants, such as slot starts from availability.

BookingStatus.description: Where a booking is in its life. Transitions are in Booking's table; anything not there is illegal.

ClosureResponse.description: A time a resource (or the whole venue) is closed. localStart/localEnd are venue wall-clock "yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm".

resourceId.description: The resource to book, such as court-1.

start.description: The UTC start of the first slot, exactly as returned by the availability endpoint.

slots.description: How many consecutive slots. Leave it out for one.

name.description: The name the booking is under.

CreateBookingRequest.description:
A booking request. The attributes check its shape at the boundary (400 with field errors); whether the booking is
allowed is a business rule checked in Core (409/422 with a code). Library: 8.5 "Three layers of validation".

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, such as court-3.

CreateResourceRequest.description: A new resource. The id becomes part of URLs and cannot change later.

OpeningHoursRequest.description: One day's opening hours, in venue-local time.

code.description: Stable error code such as slot_taken or too_late_to_cancel. Clients switch on this, not on title.

open.description: Venue-local "HH:mm", or null when closed all day.

ScheduleResponse.description: The day schedule: one column per resource.

SetHoursRequest.description: The whole week. Days that are left out are closed.

movedBookings.description: Bookings made before signing in (on this browser) that now belong to the account.

email.description: The email to sign in with.

name.description: Your name, shown in the account menu and suggested for bookings.

SignUpRequest.description: Create an account. The password needs at least 10 characters; no other rules.

SlotState.description: Past wins over Closed, Closed over Booked: a slot is shown with the most decisive reason it cannot be booked.

StaffActions.description: What staff may do to a booking right now (the domain's transition table plus its guards).

StaffBookingResponse.description: A booking as staff see it on the schedule.

StaffCancelRequest.description: Cancel a booking as staff. The customer sees the reason.

UpdateResourceRequest.description: Changes to a resource. The id stays the same.

code.description: Stable error code such as slot_taken or too_late_to_cancel. Clients switch on this, not on title.
